summary: Frontend E2E testing of Admin Project Planning module (React + FastAPI/Postgres). Verified Admin & Client login (demo buttons + credentials), Dashboard stats/chart, Projects list with status/client filters + debounced search, New Project validation + create-and-append flow, Project Detail overview/phases/tracking tabs, PhaseTimeline with Add Phase (duplicate sequence_order rejection + valid add), ProgressUpdateFeed (Blocked flag badge), Clients page + client-specific project drill-in, and Role-based UI restrictions for the Client role (Clients nav hidden, New Project / Add Phase / Post Update / Edit Project buttons hidden, only own client's projects visible, internal updates hidden). Result: 17/18 checks passed. One real bug found in optimistic-update wiring.

ui_bugs.issue: Optimistic update for new progress updates never appears in the feed, and the feed count/list does not refresh after a successful POST. Toast 'Update posted' fires and DB actually stores the update (verified via GET /api/projects/1/updates returning 5 items), but the on-screen 'Progress Feed · N updates' counter stays stale and the new row is missing. RCA: query-key type mismatch. ProjectDetailPage.jsx line 31 calls useUpdatesFeed(id) where id is a STRING from useParams -> query key is ['updates', '1']. But ProjectDetailPage passes projectId={Number(id)} to ProgressUpdateFormModal, and usePostUpdate (hooks/useProjects.js lines 127/128/138/150) does cancelQueries/getQueryData/setQueryData/invalidateQueries with ['updates', 1] (NUMBER). React Query treats those as different keys -> getQueryData returns undefined (no optimistic insert) and invalidateQueries does not refetch the mounted list. Fix: pass Number(id) into useUpdatesFeed OR use useUpdatesFeed(Number(id)) OR coerce consistently in the hook.

action_items: Fix optimistic update queryKey type mismatch in /app/frontend/src/features/projectPlanning/pages/ProjectDetailPage.jsx (or hooks/useProjects.js) so useUpdatesFeed and usePostUpdate use the SAME projectId type (both Number). This will fix both the optimistic insert and the auto-refresh after posting an update. Also confirm phase/project mutations don't have the same issue (grep for other places passing string id to useProject vs Number to mutations).
critical_code_review_comments: useUpdatesFeed(id) is called with a string (from useParams) but invalidate/setQueryData use Number(id) — inconsistent query keys break React Query cache. Same pattern risk in useProject(id) vs invalidateProject(qc, Number(id)) — audit all callers.

ProgressUpdateFormModal closes the dialog BEFORE awaiting mutateAsync; when the mutation errors, the modal is already gone and the user only sees a toast — consider closing on success only, or re-opening on error, so users can retry without re-typing.
Login page produces two 401s from /api/auth/me before login — expected but noisy; consider gating the auth-probe on a stored flag.

Total updates on project 1 is now 5. Main agent may want to reseed if a clean state is needed for demos.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend backend URL: https://portal-construction.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend uses PostgreSQL (service postgresql start) — NOT MongoDB. Auth via httpOnly cookies (axios withCredentials). Data loads for /api/projects can take 2-3s on first paint; wait for [data-testid="project-row-1"] with 15s timeout, then poll. Radix Select triggers are BUTTONs — use click + get_by_role('option', name=...).click. Test data prefixed with TEST_ was left in DB. Post-update form testid for submit is 'update-form-submit' (not 'update-submit-button' as spec mentioned); phase form submit is 'phase-form-submit'; phase sequence input is 'phase-order-input'. Re-run the optimistic-update flow after fix: click post-update-button, fill update-description-input with a unique marker, click update-form-submit, poll [data-testid="progress-update-feed"] every 200ms — marker MUST appear within <500ms (optimistic) and 'Progress Feed · N updates' count must increment by 1.
rca of the issue: Optimistic update broken due to React Query key type mismatch: useUpdatesFeed(useParams().id) => key ['updates', '1' (string)], but usePostUpdate is called with projectId=Number(id) => key ['updates', 1 (number)]. Reproduction: login as Admin, open project 1, click Tracking tab, click Post Update, type description, submit. Observed: toast 'Update posted' shows, DB has new row (curl /api/projects/1/updates confirms), but on-screen feed and count remain unchanged until a hard reload/navigation. Fix: normalize projectId to Number in useUpdatesFeed (or pass Number(id) at the call site in ProjectDetailPage.jsx:31). Same audit needed for other hooks/invalidations that mix string params with number-cast mutation args.
